title: NASA: This El Niño May Rival the 1997 Giant
paragraphs: El Niño is a warm ocean event. It happens in the Pacific Ocean. It changes the weather in many places.
In 2026, a new El Niño is growing fast. NASA looked at satellite photos of the sea. The sea is very high and warm now. This looks like 1997. In 1997, there was a very big El Niño.
Scientists do not know all the effects. Rain can come to some places. Where it will come is not clear.

questions.a: A warm ocean event in the Pacific.

questions.q: Do scientists know all the effects?
